plaid.title: Bank and brokerage connections
plaid.description: Connect your U.S. accounts directly with Plaid. American Express credit cards and Merrill Edge self-directed accounts are supported. Daily updates begin after you review the first import.
plaid.failed: The connection could not be completed. Retry or reconnect.
plaid.anotherLogin: I am connecting another login at this institution.
plaid.limits: Creating another connection may count toward your Plaid plan’s connection limit.
plaid.disconnectConfirm: Revoke this connection? Imported financial history will be kept. A failed revocation stays pending until it succeeds.
plaid.mappingHelp: Create a new account or link a compatible existing account.
plaid.merrillConfirm: These are Merrill Edge self-directed accounts.
plaid.reviewHelp: Review posted transactions and confirm the opening balance against your statement. Pending transactions wait until posted. Matched transfers import after both account previews are approved.
plaid.opening: Opening balance (cash is positive; debt is negative)
plaid.pairHelp: Choose the other account and its corresponding transaction. Equal amounts alone do not establish a match.
plaid.historyHelp: Holdings determine current values. Investment transactions are provider history and do not establish complete historical performance. Provider buys show cash outflows as positive and sales as negative.
plaid.opaqueConfirm: Use Plaid’s reported values for instruments in this preview without a supported market identity. They will be tracked separately with provider-supplied prices.
plaid.cutover: Import starting on (existing transaction history only)
plaid.cutoverHelp: For an existing bank or card account, choose a date after its last recorded transaction. Existing history is preserved; stop overlapping CSV imports. Leave this blank for an empty account.
plaid.removedHelp: Plaid removed these records. Unedited records are removed on approval. If import is blocked, inspect the linked local activities and resolve any edits or transfer pairing explicitly, then retry approval. You may keep the account paused; local edits are never discarded automatically.
plaid.removeConnectionConfirm: Remove this unused disconnected connection? Local accounts and imported history will be kept.
plaid.noProviderAccounts: Plaid returned no accounts. Retry, or use Reconnect and authorize the accounts you want to share.
plaid.noEligibleAccounts: None of the accounts Plaid returned are supported for this connection. Reconnect and check which accounts you authorized.
plaid.noLocalAccounts: No compatible local account. You can create a new account here.

investments.coverage: Available history starts {{date}} ({{transactions}} source records). Earlier performance is incomplete.
investments.blocked: Resolve these issues before importing. Unsupported records cannot be skipped.
investments.confirmInitial: I reviewed the opening balances and history and approve switching this account to transaction tracking.
investments.confirmUpdate: I reviewed these changes and approve updating the ledger.

issues.unsupportedInstrument: This instrument or short position is not supported.
issues.missingCancellation: The original transaction for this cancellation is unavailable.
issues.unsupportedTransaction: This transaction type, currency, or amount cannot be imported safely.
issues.openingShort: The history implies an unsupported short opening position.
issues.negativePosition: The history produces a negative position.
issues.reconciliation: The ledger does not match current holdings or cash.
issues.tradeValues: Trade quantity is included in the opening-position preview, but its price, cash amount or fees do not reconcile. Verify the source record before importing.
issues.reviewedTransferChanged: A previously reviewed transfer changed its quantity, security, date or fees. Its saved cost cannot be reused automatically. Verify the corrected source and reconcile this transfer before importing.

evidence.title: Fill opening costs from a PDF or CSV
evidence.help: Use a statement with cost basis at the opening cutoff, or complete security transaction history. This proposes aggregate opening costs only; it does not import older activities or original tax lots.
evidence.privacy: PDF text is extracted in your browser. The reviewed table uses the existing CSV parser on your Wealthfolio server. Files are not saved or sent to an AI service.
evidence.file: Statement PDF or transaction/position CSV (maximum 10 MB)
evidence.tableHelp: Keep one account and one table, including its header. Remove statement prose, totals and repeated headers. Columns may be separated by commas or tabs. Verify the PDF extraction against your statement; scanned PDFs are unsupported.
evidence.positions: Position cost basis at the opening cutoff
evidence.transactions: Security transactions from an empty position
evidence.costHelp: Use U.S. numbers (1,234.56) and ISO dates or MM/DD/YYYY. Total cost means acquisition basis including fees, or the reported basis removed by a SELL—not proceeds or market value. BUY and SELL are the only supported actions. Splits, transfers, reinvestments and other basis adjustments require a verified position statement instead.
evidence.cutoffHelp: The source must establish positions at the end of {{date}} in {{currency}}. Earlier statements need intervening activity; later statements cannot substitute. If no currency column exists, verify the source currency before applying.
evidence.complete: I verified complete security history from zero holdings or the starting statement through the cutoff, in the displayed currency, in chronological row order for same-day trades. All basis adjustments are accounted for, and each sale reports the basis of the actual shares sold.
evidence.excluded: Rows outside the required history interval excluded: {{count}}
evidence.matchHelp: Select only securities from this account and currency. Quantities must match, except for a tiny remainder explicitly excluded from the active statement. Verify each security yourself. Unmatched rows are not applied. This does not repair missing transaction history.
evidence.fractionalMatch: Matches {{quantity}} shares, including {{excluded}} excluded shares. Total cost remains {{currency}} {{total}}; the excluded fraction adds no cost. Applied cost per unit: {{unitCost}}.
evidence.confirm: I verified the source account, currency, cutoff date, security identities, quantities and cost basis against my records. These are costs, not market values.

errors.number: Use a nonnegative U.S. decimal number with at most 18 decimal places; quantity must be positive.
errors.date: Use a valid date: YYYY-MM-DD or, for CSV transaction rows, MM/DD/YYYY.
errors.cutoff: Use a statement on or before the opening cutoff; transaction history must end at that cutoff. A starting statement must be earlier and use this account currency.
errors.history: Confirm that transaction history is complete before calculating.
errors.columns: Map required columns and map each source column at most once.
errors.size: Use a nonempty file up to 10 MB, at most 100 PDF pages, one million text characters and 10,000 data rows.
errors.structure: The table could not be read safely. Correct its header, column counts and data rows, then retry.
errors.currency: The source currency does not match this account.
errors.security: Each row needs an explicit security identifier.
errors.duplicate: Duplicate position or transaction rows require review. No proposal was applied.
errors.conflict: Reported total basis conflicts with quantity times unit cost.
errors.action: Unsupported action. Use BUY/SELL history with complete costs or a verified position statement.
errors.saleBasis: A purchase needs total basis or price and fees. A sale needs the reported cost basis removed, not proceeds. Unknown fees must be resolved before applying.
errors.incomplete: The history produces negative holdings/basis or leaves cost without shares. Check missing trades, row order and adjustments.
errors.empty: No nonzero opening positions were found.
errors.file: Choose a valid PDF or CSV file.
errors.scanned: This PDF has no extractable text. Use a text-based statement or a CSV export; OCR is not supported.
errors.pdf: The PDF could not be read within the limits. Use an unlocked text-based PDF or CSV.
errors.parse: The table could not be parsed. Review its contents and retry.
errors.brokerageFormat: This file does not match the selected brokerage format/version. Choose the correct format or use explicit manual mapping.
errors.brokerageAccount: All files must identify the same account. Account and period headers within each statement must agree.
errors.brokeragePending: Only settled records are supported. Export settled activity again.
errors.brokerageRecord: This record cannot be interpreted safely by this format. Do not remove basis-changing events to force an import.
errors.brokerageBasis: A position is missing verified quantity or cost basis. Market value cannot substitute.
errors.brokerageReconcile: The extracted positions do not reconcile with the printed section totals, or a section/symbol is incomplete.
errors.noBasisTrades: No supported purchase records were found. Cash-only records alone do not establish opening security cost basis.
errors.batchSize: Batch limits: 10 MB per file, 25 MB total, one million extracted characters and 10,000 data rows.
errors.batchFormat: For multiple files, choose a supported brokerage format. Manual mapping accepts one file.
errors.batchConflict: Statements with the same closing date disagree. Select one verified version.
errors.purchaseAmounts: Purchase amounts disagree beyond the exported price precision. Verify quantity, unit price and net cash debit against Merrill.
errors.merrillSaleBasis: This Merrill sale reports proceeds, not disposed cost basis. Supply verified sold-share basis using manual mapping, or use a position statement after the sale and on or before the opening cutoff.
errors.transferBasis: This security transfer needs verified transferred cost basis. Use manually mapped history with verified costs, or a position statement after the transfer and on or before the opening cutoff.
errors.adjustmentBasis: This transfer/adjustment may change cost basis. Use a verified position statement after the event and on or before the opening cutoff. Do not remove the event to force a result.
errors.noWindowRecords: No records fall within the required opening-history interval. Upload an earlier statement and activity after that statement through the opening cutoff. Later activity belongs to ongoing history.

evidence.checkpoint: Starting statement: {{date}} ({{count}} positions). Kept in memory for this review only.
evidence.useCheckpoint: Use statement, then upload intervening CSV
evidence.bridgeHelp: This statement predates the opening cutoff. Review it, then upload a CSV covering every security transaction and basis adjustment after this statement through the cutoff. Use the same security identifiers in both tables; edit the extracted table if necessary. Sales still need their reported disposed cost basis. No cost can be applied until the combined quantities reconcile.
evidence.formatHelp: Select the exact export version. Supported brokerage formats use fixed mappings; unfamiliar layouts or records stop with an error. Manual mapping is a separate advanced option.
evidence.cashRows: Cash-only records excluded from security cost basis: {{count}}; source rows: {{rows}}

formats.merrill-settled-activity-v1: Merrill Edge — Settled Activity CSV v1
formats.merrill-cma-statement-v1: Merrill Edge — CMA monthly statement PDF v1

evidence.batchHelp: Select up to 5 supported PDF/CSV files from this brokerage: 10 MB per file and 25 MB total. Manual mapping accepts one file. A new selection replaces the current batch.
evidence.excludeUnavailableBasis: Exclude statement entries explicitly marked with unavailable cost basis from this evidence only. Changing this option clears the current evidence and starting checkpoint; upload again.
evidence.excludedBasisHelp: Excluded evidence entries: {{total}}. These holdings remain tracked. Any required opening position still needs verified cost basis. Exclusions are kept only in this review.
evidence.outsideRows: Records outside the required history interval: {{total}}. Opening cutoff: {{date}}.

investments.transferCostHelp: Enter the verified book cost per unit for each incoming security transfer. Market value is not cost basis. Previously reviewed transfer costs are retained for later syncs.
